description: Count verified B2B businesses in the LeadQuasar database matching an industry, country, US state and/or city, with how many have an email address and a phone number. Use this to answer questions like 'how many managed service providers are there in Texas', 'how many dentists in Chicago have a business email' or 'how many movers are there in London' (country GB). Returns real counts from 7.5 million live records, most of them US.

city.description: City name, e.g. "Chicago", or "London" with country GB.

country.description: Country, as an ISO code ("US", "GB", "CA") or a name ("United Kingdom"). Omit to count every country. Coverage outside the US is much smaller. Countries with data: United States (US), Canada (CA), United Arab Emirates (AE), Australia (AU), United Kingdom (GB), India (IN).

industry.description: Industry or business type in plain words, e.g. 'managed service provider', 'dentist', 'HVAC contractor', 'plumbers'. Everyday wording is resolved to the stored categories, so 'HVAC contractor' finds HVAC and 'plumbers' covers both Plumbers and Plumbing. The response reports which category it matched.

no_website.description: true = only businesses whose Google Maps listing shows no website of their own (read from the listing; a Facebook-only listing counts as none). For questions like 'restaurants in Dubai without a website' or 'plumbers in Texas with no website'.

state.description: US state, either full name ("Texas") or two-letter code ("TX"). US only.

name: count_businesses
title: Count businesses
